payload.description_html: The Skink had no chance. The Egret was swift and quick, and then held the Skink in the mouth like a trophy and displayed for a minute or two and finally swallowed it head first. One of the few shots at a wonderful birding spot, that had very little activity due to a large event there. The clean-up has not commenced, so was a disappointing trip. Many thanks in advance for your views and feedback. Much appreciated.
